info.name: Carepoint HMS — Full API Postman Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for the Carepoint Hospital Management System.

Covers authentication, RBAC, patients, visits, queues, clinical (triage/vitals/consult/diagnosis), lab, radiology, pharmacy, surgical / theatre, admissions, discharge, billing, invoices, payments, ambulance dispatch, insurance claims, notifications, compliance / governance, and reports.

How to use:
1. Set `base_url` (default http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1).
2. Update `admin_email` / `admin_password` to a seeded user.
3. Run `01 Authentication > POST /auth/login` — the test script auto-captures `access_token` / `refresh_token`.
4. Path placeholders like `:patient_id` should be replaced with real IDs (or wired through environment variables).
